methodology.title: Dual Track Discovery and Delivery
methodology.passage: Dual Track Discovery and Delivery. When to use it. Dual track working separates learning what to build from building it. A discovery track tests hypotheses quickly and cheaply; only validated ideas move into a delivery track. This archetype suits machine learning research, new market exploration, data products whose feasibility is unproven, and any initiative where the biggest risk is building the wrong thing or ...

methodology.title: Workflow Selection Heuristics
methodology.passage: Workflow Selection Heuristics. Primary questions. * How much of the work is known before it starts? High uncertainty favours Scrum or dual track discovery; fixed, baselined scope favours a stage gate lifecycle. * How does work arrive?
